---
title: Describe what you want
description: How to write a request the builder can act on, add pictures or PDFs, and ask for a new look.
sidebar:
  order: 4
---

A good request is short and concrete. You can start with a sentence, as we did for the coffee shop, and then refine the site message by message.

1. Say what the site is and who it is for. *A website for a small coffee shop.*
2. Name the pages or the things visitors must be able to do. *The menu, opening hours, and a form to book a table.*
3. Add anything you care about: the name, the tone, colors, your real menu and prices, your real opening hours. Whatever you leave out, the builder fills in with sensible defaults, and you can ask it to change them later.
4. Send the message with Enter. Use Shift + Enter for a new line.

![The coffee shop request typed in the New agent box, before it is sent.](/images/build/start-website-1.webp)

## Change the site message by message

Ask for one change at a time and look at Preview after each. *Make the booking form ask for a phone number.* *Change the opening hours to 8:00 to 17:00 on weekdays.* *Add a Weekend brunch section to the menu.* Describe what you want visitors to see or do, not how to code it.

## Add pictures or a PDF

Click **+** (**Attach file**) at the bottom left of the chat box, drop files onto the box, or paste a screenshot. You can attach JPEG, PNG and WebP images and PDF files, up to 5 per message. Each one shows as a chip with its name and size, with a button to remove it. If an upload fails the chip offers **Retry**. A pasted screenshot on its own is a complete message, so you can show the builder something and send it without adding text.

## Point at something on the page

When Preview supports it, a pencil appears in the Preview toolbar. Click it to turn on **Edit mode**, then click any element on the page to pick it. It appears as a chip above your message, so you can say *make this heading smaller* without explaining where it is. In **Edit mode** you can also change text or style directly on the page. An **Apply** button, which shows how many changes you made, keeps them, and **Discard** drops them.

## Ask for a new look

An ordinary request changes the site inside its current design. If you ask for a completely different look, the builder can offer **Redesign the visual style** above the chat box, with a short line saying what it understood. Click it to go ahead with that request.

## Good to know

- Not sure what to ask for? Choose **Brainstorm** and let the builder ask. See [Build and Brainstorm](/build/modes/).
- You cannot send a message while the builder is working. Wait for **Done**, or stop the turn. See [Follow progress](/build/progress/).
- Something you want that is not a page, such as sending an email or taking a payment? See [What your site can do](/build/what-your-site-can-do/).
